events.factual_description: COTTON CLUB presents Richard Galliano New Viaggio Trio on Monday and Tuesday, November 16-17, 2026. Each night has a first show opening at 17:00 and starting at 18:00, and a second show opening at 19:45 and starting at 20:30. The announced trio is Richard Galliano on accordion and bandoneon, Adrien Moignard on guitar, and Philippe Aerts on bass. The venue frames the engagement around a reinterpretation of Galliano's 1993 album Viaggio and identifies it as Galliano's first COTTON CLUB appearance. Published seat charges run from ¥9,000 for table seats to ¥11,500 for center box seats, with other seat categories between those amounts. The event-specific reservation destination is live but currently states that booking has not opened: JAM SESSION member presale begins September 10 at 12:00 and general web reservations begin September 16 at 12:00.

en.why_it_matters: Galliano has spent decades turning the accordion from a coloristic guest into a front-line improvising voice, and New Viaggio puts that identity under a useful constraint: no drums, just his accordion and bandoneon against Adrien Moignard's guitar and Philippe Aerts's bass. Revisiting the 1993 Viaggio book with a different generation of partners makes this less a nostalgia set than a live test of how new musette, tango and jazz change when the rhythmic engine is carried entirely by three melodic instruments.
en.trip_verdict: If Greater Tokyo is in play on November 16 or 17, I would actively make room for one of the four sets and let the trio anchor that part of the evening. The two-night run gives enough flexibility that I would fit it around scarcer farewells, premieres or one-off master appearances rather than reorganize an entire Japan itinerary around it.

es.why_it_matters: Galliano lleva décadas convirtiendo al acordeón de un color invitado en una voz improvisadora de primera línea, y New Viaggio pone esa identidad bajo una restricción muy fértil: sin batería, sólo su acordeón y bandoneón frente a la guitarra de Adrien Moignard y el bajo de Philippe Aerts. Volver al repertorio de Viaggio de 1993 con compañeros de otra generación hace que esto sea menos un ejercicio de nostalgia que una prueba en vivo de cómo cambian el new musette, el tango y el jazz cuando todo el motor rítmico recae en tres instrumentos melódicos.
es.trip_verdict: Si Greater Tokyo está en juego el 16 o 17 de noviembre, sí haría espacio activamente para uno de los cuatro sets y dejaría que el trío ancle esa parte de la noche. Las dos noches dan suficiente flexibilidad como para acomodarlo alrededor de despedidas, estrenos o apariciones realmente escasas de grandes maestros, en vez de reorganizar todo un viaje a Japón por esta fecha.
